title: Remote Codex Workspace Provisioning
business: Independent software consultants managing multiple client environments.
problem: Local development environments often suffer from configuration drift and resource constraints, leading to inconsistent build results and slow compilation times when working on complex projects.
solution: By utilizing a DigitalOcean droplet as a remote Codex workspace, consultants can standardize their development environment in the cloud, ensuring consistent performance and isolation for every client project.
steps: Authenticate the ChatGPT session with the DigitalOcean API using a personal access token.
Define the droplet configuration including region, image, and size parameters.
Trigger the droplet creation request through the plugin interface.
Verify the droplet status and retrieve the public IP address for SSH access.
Initialize the remote workspace with necessary development tools and project dependencies.
outcome: A consistent, high-performance, and isolated cloud-based development environment that eliminates local machine configuration issues.
limitation: The primary limitation is network latency between the local terminal and the remote droplet, which can impact real-time feedback; this is checked by monitoring round-trip time (RTT) during SSH sessions.
